name: Arli AI
description: Open-model and fine-tune host whose $0 plan covers a single derestricted Qwen model.
overview: Arli AI serves open models and community fine-tunes on flat monthly plans. The $0 Free plan is deliberately narrow: one derestricted Qwen model, one request at a time, with a 12K context cap. It suits light roleplay and testing rather than production workloads.
notes: Free plan covers a single model with one concurrent request and a 12K context ceiling.
